contentPattern.structure: 3-column grid of bordered article cards; each card = thumbnail image + H3 title + short description; the whole card links to an article page

suitableFor: grids of article/resource cards that link to detail pages
testimonial and blog listing rows (image + title + teaser description)
any 'title + description' card grid where the whole card is a link
notSuitableFor: promo/navigation cards with a large image and an explicit 'Learn More' CTA (use cards-promo)
